fields.meta_title: PayPal Donation Form Builder for Nonprofits | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a PayPal donation form that tags each gift to a fund, logs monthly gifts, and keeps donor records in a database you own. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a PayPal Donation Form That Records Every Gift
fields.hero_description: Build a PayPal donation form that ties each gift to a fund and saves the PayPal transaction in a database you own.
fields.features_subheading: The PayPal pop-up takes the gift. The PayPal donation form around it saves the donor, the fund, and the transaction to your database.
fields.feature_1:
A gift form written from one prompt

Describe the funds you raise for and the amounts to suggest. Emergent builds the form, the donor tables, and a staff screen, then changes any of them each time you prompt again.
fields.feature_2:
Donors stay on your site to pay

The app connects to your PayPal account and opens the Donate pop-up over your page. PayPal says this keeps donors on your website instead of redirecting them to a PayPal page.
fields.feature_3:
The transaction ID saved on the gift

PayPal returns a transaction ID when a gift completes, and the app saves it on the gift row beside the amount and fund. Matching a PayPal statement line to a donor takes one search.
fields.feature_4:
Monthly gifts with every cycle logged

A monthly gift runs as a PayPal subscription, billed at regular intervals. Each cycle, PayPal posts an event to the app, and the payment joins that donor's history as a new row.
fields.feature_5:
First-time donors reach a person

A donor's first gift sends an email or Slack message to whoever writes welcome notes, with the fund and amount attached. A reminder follows 2 days later if no note is marked sent.
fields.feature_6:
Your code, in your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and host the form wherever your website already runs. The PayPal connection and the donor tables go with it.

plan.angle: Searchers for a PayPal donation form find PayPal's own button docs and generic form builders; neither shows what happens to the gift record. This page shows the form around the PayPal Donate pop-up: the donor picks a fund on the organization's own site, the PayPal transaction ID lands on the gift row, monthly gifts run as PayPal subscriptions whose every cycle is logged, student fundraiser links roll up to one board, and a refund started in the PayPal business dashboard comes off the total. Builder intent only; PayPal is the processor the reader already uses, no partnership implied.
tab_stories: At Cobbleford Community Pantry, Oksana Feldmanis gives $60 to the Weekend Backpacks fund in the PayPal pop-up without leaving the pantry's site, and the app saves the PayPal transaction ID on her gift row.
Ilario Pesce gives Brindle Hollow Animal Rescue $25 a month as a PayPal subscription; when payment 4 comes through, the app adds it to his record, which now shows $100 given.
Cindermoor High Robotics Boosters gives 14 students their own fundraiser link; gifts through each link are tagged to that student, and Ambrose Tuck leads the board with $420 from 9 donors.

Jory Holloran's $150 gift to Peregrine Choir Society is refunded from the PayPal business dashboard; the app marks the gift Refunded, emails treasurer Bettina Quarles, and the year's total drops from $8,450 to $8,300.
